gem.incomingTip:
Incoming damage
x → y  —  the HP you'll take if you play no more block (current block + end-of-turn relics),
reducible to y by mitigation: playing your hand's block and Weaken/debuffs optimally.
(Killing an attacker is offense — see the red gem — not counted here.)
gem.offenseTip:
Your damage
x + d  —  the most you can deal to a SINGLE enemy before it acts (each enemy solved on its own,
including its share of AOE), plus d that lands on its own before your next turn (poison etc.).
Hover an enemy to scope to it; the energy gem glows green when you can kill it.
